open_risks: TRANSFERRED to the successor. 0092: step 7 execs the preflight with no MITOSIS_BOUNDARY_* env, it exits 31 with no stdout, and every run halts at preflight-boundary. Fail-closed, so availability not security - but the engine is unusable, and permanently so under 0095.

TRANSFERRED. 0092 corollary: layer 2 has NEVER worked end-to-end, not even before the severance - which is why a week-long severance went unnoticed. Scheduler tests stub the verdict and never exec the CLI.

TRANSFERRED. 0093 MEDIUM: ~/.claude/lib symlinks into this repo, so both boundary layers exec the SAME mutable file inside the repo under management. invokedAs is string equality on an unresolved path and cannot detect a poisoned gate.
TRANSFERRED. 0094: the config guard does not cover git worktrees at all, and mitosis puts every fanned-out agent in one. Shown live this session.

DURABLE LESSON: subagent self-reports are NOT trustworthy - one committed while reporting 'no commit, no push'. Verify against the repository, always. This session's cleanup was gated on blob-level comparison to origin/main, never on a report.

DURABLE LESSON: never site a worktree in another session's scratchpad. Also beware the inverse error made here - the spine called that scratchpad 'dead' when it was live and held 3 modified files. Both directions of that assumption must be checked, not asserted.
DURABLE LESSON: local main was 8 behind origin/main while the spine described main as green. Always re-derive the baseline from the remote before judging what has landed.
